profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at Amazon
profile.summary: 15+ years as a software engineer for companies ranging from Amazon to an AI2 startup. Experience launching customer-facing websites, scaling services for Cyber Monday peak traffic, designing cloud-based distributed systems, and analyzing billions of transactions in marketing experiments. Specialties: Distributed systems, cloud architectures, behavioral targeting & experimentation, data analysis/statistics, online marketing, machine learning.

positions.description:
Lexion helps legal teams save time & money by automatically reading and organizing contracts. We apply cutting-edge natural language processing to extract meaning from documents, and package this into an intuitive application that customers love. 

Lexion was developed at a world class research institute (AI2), is backed by an iconic Silicon Valley law firm (Wilson Sonsini), and funded by a prestigious VC firm (Madrona).

We are hiring!

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Lead software engineer for Skylight: a real-time global monitoring system for fishing activity and marine domain awareness. http://www.skylight.global/

Built a platform for running ML models and analytic algorithms on a event processing system (Kafka Streams). Developed technology that is the basis of two pending patents for satellite based maritime monitoring.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
*Designed, architected, created CRM Messaging Service, which schedules, prioritizes and displays Groupon promotions on the Groupon website, mobile app, email and in push notifications. Handles daily peak traffic of over 20,000 requests per second. (Java/Cassandra/MySQL stack).
* Scaled Incentive Service, a discount and promotions service at Groupon from a few 1000 requests per second to handle peak loads of 40,000 requests per second.

positions.title: Sr. Software Development Engineer (SDE III), Behavior-Based Email Targeting
positions.description:
•	Led project and team of 3 to migrate our largest automated email targeting system to Elastic Map Reduce (Hadoop) architecture. Reduced processing time from multiple days to hours, while increasing circulation and revenue ~20% in several countries.
•	Wrote proposal and roadmap to revamp targeting and architecture of our oldest email targeting system. Reversed two years of declining revenue, while reducing total circulation and unsubscribes (increasing revenue/mail by 4x).
•	Key contributor to the design and launch of our next-generation email recommendation platform which is built on the cloud services Elastic Map Reduce, S3 and EC2. Managed the project to launch the first large-scale new program on this platform. The platform eliminated duplicate software stacks, reduced build times, and allowed features of any of our targeting systems to be instantly utilized by other programs on this platform.
•	Designed and executed email-channel wide experiments testing email send cadence, and analyzed of billions of rows of data for performance by customer segment. Provided recommendations to optimize revenue and manage high-risk customer segments. Team subject matter expert in experimentation and data analysis in the email channel.
•	Assisted in Black Friday/Cyber Monday scaling by adding caching to deals and promotion service calls made from every Amazon product page. Reduced p99.9 latency of the call from 10 ms to 1 ms.
•	Launched astore.amazon.com – designed & implemented the customized storefronts, key-value aStore configuration data store, and optimized service calls to increase availability from three 9s to four (>99.99% availability).


General Achievements:
•	Experienced interviewer for technical and management positions (100+ interviews to date).
•	Subject matter expert for several of our products, experimentation, analysis and statistical measurement tasks, and role-model for documentation of systems and analyses.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
•	Developed an inventory system to optimize the storage of nuclear materials in a vault according to space and criticality constraints. Returned the optimal storage location in seconds, compared to a prior manual process.
•	Modeled the flow of nuclear material through an Japanese reprocessing facility to verify International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA) Material Balance controls were placed appropriately throughout the facility. Traveled to Japan to present our software to our customers.

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description:
•	Updated and developed the “ICQ Opinion Place” web site, which registered hundreds of panel members in five languages per day.
•	Created and tested prototype Java and Visual Basic programs to explore the feasibility of playing password-protected video clips on CDs.

projects.title: Email Marketing Analytics
projects.description:
Created a series of reporting decks for automated email targeting systems with the following outcomes:
•	Identified and fixed a broken segment in one program, recovering an estimated $1.5 million in yearly revenue. 
•	Made uneven category coverage in a targeting program transparent, which caused merchandisers to increase category coverage and resulted in ~60% YoY revenue growth for our largest automated email targeting system.
•	Identified and blocked clusters of poorly performing targeting types which generated just 3% of revenue but were responsible for 17% of opt-outs. 

•	Owner for testing and integrating customer-level decision-making into our email systems. Designing, executing, and analyzing large-scale experiments to test optimal send cadence for different customer segments.
•	Analyzed factors contributing the YoY growth rate of the email channel in all Amazon countries. Built reporting pivot tables, identified segments leading and lagging growth, and wrote a document explaining the growth factors and listing actions to improve growth. The document was used as a source of actions for the yearly business plan and for reporting growth factors to senior executives.

projects.title: New Email Targeting Systems
projects.description:
•	Launched a new behavioral-targeting program which produces millions of $/year in revenue and is our highest revenue/mail automated program. Vocally pushed for the immediate launch of this program, adding several million to our end of year revenue. Tested subject line and targeting windows to maximize incremental revenue generation. Added new customer experience filters to the program which contributed to this having the lowest opt-out rate of our automated targeting programs.
•	Key contributor to the design and launch of our next-generation email recommendation platform which is built on Elastic Map Reduce, S3 and EC2. Managed projects to launch the first large-scale new program on this platform and to migrate our largest automated email program to the new platform.
•	Wrote the roadmap for revamping the automated new release email notification program. Listed targeting problems in the previous system, ran and analyzed A/B tests of a new targeting system and creative, and wrote a proposal of 6-7 improvements and architectural changes to make in the new system. The new system incorporated my proposed changes and resulted in a 2-3x gross revenue increase while sending only half of the mail volume.
